- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Lake District National Park Authority promotes low-carbon travel options, implements wildlife conservation initiatives, and encourages respect for the local environment.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Blaenavon regeneration project promotes sustainable tourism through sustainable transport links, energy-efficient buildings, and support for local businesses and cultural heritage.
